name: signature-pad

frames.best_why: Completed wavy signature with the Signed status and the Submit button enabled.

tagline: Draw a signature by hand on a pad, then undo, clear or submit it.
summary: A canvas signature field. Strokes follow the pointer with springy, speed-tapered ink, and a signed state unlocks the Submit button after Undo or Clear.
appearance: A rounded card with a small uppercase lease label, a bold heading and a grey term line. Below, a pad holds a faint baseline and an x Sign here hint, with a pale wavy signature inked across it. A footer row shows status, Undo and Clear above a full-width Submit button.
behaviour: Drawing on the pad lays down tapered ink that trails the pointer with a slight lag and thickens when slow. The status flips to Signed and Submit brightens; Undo peels back the last stroke and Clear wipes the whole signature with a fade.
demo_content: Lease agreement for Unit 4B, twelve months from March 1 2027 at $2,450 per month.
search_phrases: draw your signature with a mouse
sign here box for a contract
use_when: A contract or form needs a quick hand-drawn signature captured in the browser and exported as an image.
avoid_when: Signing needs a pointer or finger; there is no typed, uploaded or keyboard-drawn fallback.
customise: Only a label and an onChange callback are exposed; ink colour, line weight, spring constants and pad size are set in the source.
weight_why: Canvas 2D paints only while a stroke or clear runs; the frame loop stops when idle.

a11y.note: The pad focuses and shortcuts undo or clear, but a signature cannot be drawn from the keyboard; reduced motion is respected.

issues: No typed or uploaded signature fallback for people who cannot draw with a pointer.
polish_why: Believable ink physics, clear status, tidy footer and sensible disabled states.
